description: Remove ONE account from an MCP server: the account and its credential are deleted, so the user is signed out of it, while the server and its other accounts stay. This is destructive. Call it only once the user has typed a request to remove that account by name: a yes to your question or a tap on an option does not count, so ask them to type the request themselves, such as remove Weather, instead of confirming with a question widget. Only remove an account the user asked to remove, never to fix a sign-in that is failing: sign that account in again with AuthenticateMcpServer instead. To remove a whole custom server (every account), use UninstallMcpServer; to remove a server's whole plugin (every connector, skill, and account), use UninstallPlugin.

account_label.description: The account's label exactly as shown by GetMcpServerStatus (account="…"); the quoted form is accepted verbatim.

server_id.description: The server identifier shown by GetMcpServerStatus. It is the same identifier that GetDynamicTools and CallDynamicTool address, e.g. "dashboard-team-1-Slack". Never a display name.
